 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJESH KUMAR VERMA  ORAL ORDER 2 08-07-2024 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The present writ petition has been filed for a direction upon the respondents to make payment of Rs. 30,52,800/- and Rs. 4,10,43,200/- in terms of respective Award No. 76 and 77 in Land Acquisition Case No. 06/13-14 and Notices were issued under Section 37(2) of the Land Acquisition Act, 2013 to the petitioner.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that despite of award prepared in long back in the year 2018 and compensation amount has not been paid as yet by the respondent authority.
4.

In view of the aforesaid, the respondent-State is directed to file a respective counter affidavit within a period of two weeks failing which the District Magistrate, East Patna High Court CWJC No.15885 of 2022(2) dt.08-07-2024 Champaran, Motihari (respondent no. 3) shall be physically present on the next date and assist this Court in the matter.
